maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue: Event opening (Processing the Burrower, There are still enemies alive (Burrower))
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-10: "Heading to Underkeep? Then you talk to me first." A yawn cuts the sentence in half.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-100: Choose “Use brute force and give the rock pile a proper kick.”
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-101: You kick hard into the rocks. Loose stones scatter across the ground.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-102: A violent hiss explodes from the hole.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-103: Something launches itself straight at you.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-105: You crouch by the hole, breathing slow. A faint warmth brushes your hand - a tiny pulse beneath the dirt.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-107: You stay still. After a moment, the little serpent slips out, flicks its tongue, and disappears into the grass.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-108: Choose “Examine the rocks and the hole more closely.” (The snake hasn't left the tree hole yet)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-109: The stones look natural enough, worn smooth by rain and time, though the opening at the base is suspiciously clean. A faint hiss drifts from inside. Whatever lives here is small, but likely not harmless.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-11: "Lucky you." A pause. A smirk, almost.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-110: Choose “Examine the rocks and the hole more closely.” (The snake has left the tree hole)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-111: The stones look natural enough, worn smooth by rain and time, though the opening at the base is suspiciously clean.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-112: Choose “Reach inside.” (The snake hasn't left the tree hole yet)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-115: You kneel and slide your hand into the hole. Cold earth brushes your skin and then pain flares as sharp fangs sink into your flesh!
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-116: You yank your arm back as a snake bursts out of the hole, scales glistening, jaws wide.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-117: Choose “Reach inside.” (The snake has left the tree hole)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-118: You slide your hand back into the hole. You feel only cool soil and loose pebbles. Your fingers brush something round and hard.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-119: You pull it free and find an old ring, caked in dirt.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-12: "Name's Garric. They call me a gatekeeper, but we don't really have a gate. Just this fine bit of road and whatever crawls out of the woods."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-120: You reach into the hole once more. Only cold soil and small stones meet your fingers. Whatever was hidden here is long gone.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-121: Choose “Probe the hole with a stick or weapon.” (The snake hasn't left the tree hole yet)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-122: You take a fallen branch and carefully push it into the opening. For a few heartbeats there is only silence and the scrape of wood against stone. Then the branch twitches in your hands. Once, twice - before being yanked with sudden force.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-123: Choose “Probe the hole with a stick or weapon.”
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-124: The hole erupts with movement as a green snake bursts out, scales glistening, fangs bared in fury.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-125: Choose “Probe the hole with a stick or weapon.” (The snake has left the tree hole)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-126: You push a branch into the hole. Nothing...
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-127: You turn away from the rocky outcrop and continue your journey through the forest.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-128: Subsequent conversations (Jacob has not been rescued yet)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-129: Dust floats in the dim light coming through the broken shutters. The fireplace is cold, its hearth filled with old ashes.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-13: We're looking to enter the village.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-130: A single candle, long melted into a hardened pool of wax, sits atop a wooden table. Beside it lies a sealed envelope.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-131: Select “Step back from the table.” / “Leave It Be.” / “Continue.”
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-137: You take the poker and stir the cold ashes, uncovering some burned splinters and blackened fragments that crumble at the slightest touch.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-138: Whatever it was, the fire has taken the rest. Nothing else remains but cold ash.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-14: Choose “We're looking to enter the village.”
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-140: You step closer to the table. The candle has burned down to a lumpy puddle of wax.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-141: The envelope beside it is thick, folded carefully, and sealed with dark red wax. The words "If I am gone." have been written across it in a hurried hand.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-143: "Check for any trace of blood magic." (Requires Blood Mage)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-148: There are faint scratches around the seal, too small to notice from the doorway.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-149: You tilt the envelope toward the light. The wax has been warmed, lifted, and pressed back down. Clean work. Not perfect, but clean.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-15: "I'd wave you through, truly," he says, not sounding like he means it.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-150: Whoever opened it wanted Jacob to think it had remained sealed.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-151: That is rarely a comforting detail.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-152: Choose “Check for any trace of blood magic.”
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-153: You hold the envelope near your face and breathe in slowly. Wax, ash, damp wood... and beneath it, the memory of blood.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-154: Not fresh. A tiny smear hidden in the fold. You cannot tell whether it belonged to the writer, or to someone else who handled the envelope after it was sealed.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-155: Either way, the letter was not as untouched as it first appeared.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-157: You let your senses settle over the envelope, searching for the faint pressure of spellwork.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-158: Nothing answers. No ward, no curse, no lingering arcane signature.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-159: Only the wax catches your eye: a few tiny scratches around the seal, almost hidden in the red.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-16: "But I've got Burrowers south of here chewing up the ground..."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-161: "If you have found this, then I am already gone. The whispers in the dark have returned, and the village is not safe. Something ancient stirs beneath our feet, and I must uncover the truth before it is too late. Seek Khelebar in the village. He will know more. But be warned... the shadows have eyes, and they are watching."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-162: Take the letter with you. (once only)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-164: You fold the letter and slip it into your pack. If Jacob's warning matters, it is better kept close.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-166: You search the cottage more thoroughly, but find nothing of real value.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-167: Only an old mortar, likely used for potion mixing. Jacob surely wouldn't mind if you took it.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-168: "Give me a second. Places like this always hide something." (Requires Thief)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-169: Take a look at Jacob's trophy wall. (Requires Ranger)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-17: "I'll be honest with you. I'm not keen on facing them alone." He shifts uncomfortably.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-170: That mask on the wall... (Requires Blood Mage)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-171: "Wait. Let me see if this place bears the touch of the dead." (Requires Paladin)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-172: Choose “Wait. Let me see if this place bears the touch of the dead.”
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-173: You let your senses drift across the cottage, searching not for the dead themselves, but for the mark they leave behind.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-174: There is nothing. No taint. No lingering corruption.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-176: You freeze before a red-stained wooden mask nailed to the wall. Its hollow eyes stare back. Carved with the sigil of the blood.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-177: "He killed one of us," you whisper. "And kept the mask as a warning."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-178: Choose “Take a look at Jacob's trophy wall.”
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-179: You study the wall of trophies. Boar tusks, antlers, wolf skulls. Then you notice one skull hanging slightly askew.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-18: "You clear them out, I let you in. Everyone's happy. Especially me."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-180: Behind it, a small alcove hides a sheathed dagger. Well-kept, light, engraved with faint forest runes.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-181: Choose “Give me a second. Places like this always hide something.”
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-182: You run your fingers along the furniture, the floorboards, the hearth. A faint click. Loose plank.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-183: Inside, wrapped in oilcloth, rests a narrow blade etched with forest sigils. Balanced, sharp.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-185: You step out of the cottage, the door creaking shut behind you.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-186: Dark clouds gather above the trees, blotting out the last of the daylight.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-187: Lightning flashes overhead. Thunder follows almost immediately, and heavy rain begins pouring through the branches.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-188: Somewhere in the close distance, a howl pierces the downpour.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-189: Pairs of glowing red eyes appear between the trees.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-19: Ok, we are going to kill them all.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-190: Low growls rise from the darkness. Several wolves emerge from the undergrowth, their teeth bared.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-194: You find Jacob resting in the grass of a small glade beside his cabin. Faint breeze stirs his cloak. His eyes, though weary, carry the sharp gleam of a man who has stared too long into the dark.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-195: "Ah... it's you." His voice carries both relief and disbelief. "I feared I would never see your face again."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-196: "I owe you more than my thanks." He lifts a bow from beside him and offers it with steady hands.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-197: Jacob looks up as you approach his cabin once more. This time he rises to greet you, steadier on his feet than before.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-198: "Good to see you again, friend. Tell me, have you dealt with the thing in the mausoleum?"
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-199: Jacob greets you warmly as you step onto the glade. A small fire crackles beside his cabin, and the air smells faintly of pine and smoke.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-2: "Hold it there, heroes. I appreciate the enthusiasm, really, but I can still feel those things creeping around out there."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-200: He gestures for you to sit. "Stay a moment. It's been too long since I've spoken of life rather than death."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-201: You talk for a while about the forest and the village. Jacob seems more relaxed now. For once, he even manages a genuine laugh.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-202: "Whatever happens next," he says, "you've given us a fighting chance. I won't forget that."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-203: "Take it. It has served me well, and now it should serve you."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-204: Jacob's expression grows more serious. "Tell me... have you dealt with the Source in the mausoleum?"
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-205: Dialogue options (for the “Source” of the tombs that have been processed)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-207: Dialogue options (for the “Source” of the tombs that have not been processed yet)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-21: Choose “Ok, we are going to kill them all.”
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-210: Jacob nods quietly. "Then it's finally over. You've given Underkeep village a chance to live again." He opens a small wooden box and hands you an amulet wrapped in green thread.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-211: "Take this charm. It has been in my family for generations. Now it belongs to you."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-213: "Then you must hurry." He grips your arm, steady and insistent. "Do not delay my friend."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-214: There are some cracked tombstones and skeletal trees casting eerie shadows over it.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-215: In the center, slumped against a weathered wall sits a lone figure. An old monk in tattered crimson robes, his body trembling from mortal wounds. His breath is ragged, blood pooling at his feet.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-216: His sunken eyes flicker up at you, filled with something between hatred and desperate hope.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-217: "You... you could help me," he wheezes, voice barely above a whisper.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-22: "Oh, splendid. The strangers will do what Garric the Gatekeeper could not. Or rather, would not."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-220: "A clean death is mercy. Hold still, monk." (Requires Warrior)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-221: "Your spirit clings to the flesh. I can guide it..." (Requires Voidcaller)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-222: "Peace to you, brother. May the forest remember your name." (Requires Elk)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-223: "Wait. Let me see what truly stands before us." (Requires Paladin)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-224: Choose “Wait. Let me see what truly stands before us.”
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-225: You pause only for a breath, reaching past the blood and ruined flesh, searching for what still clings to the man beneath.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-226: What answers is not repentance, nor fear, but corruption. Dark and deep, steeped in malice.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-228: "No," you say coldly. "I would not help a soul like yours."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-229: At once, the monk's face twists with hateful delight. His fingers claw into the soil.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-230: "Then take this blessing instead," he hisses.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-231: Choose “Peace to you, brother. May the forest remember your name.”
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-232: The monk lets out a dry, rattling laugh. "Peace? The forest?" His voice cracks into mockery.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-233: "Your trees rot, your roots drink blood, and your peace is a lie whispered by cowards who fear death!"
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-234: He spits blood and grins, teeth red. "Pray to your trees, little druid. They'll bloom from my rot soon enough."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-235: Choose “Your spirit clings to the flesh. I can guide it...”
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-236: The monk exhales, trembling. "Guide? No... no one guides the void. It consumes, it remembers nothing."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-237: You kneel beside him, placing your hand over his heart. The pulse stutters once, then fades.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-238: For a fleeting moment, his shadow detaches, drawn into the air like smoke dissolving in darkness.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-239: "So be it," you whisper. "Return to the nothing that birthed you."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-24: "... Fine," he mutters, glancing down the road. "Let's not pretend they pay me enough for this."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-240: Choose “A clean death is mercy. Hold still, monk.”
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-241: "Mercy?" the monk snarls through broken teeth. "You know nothing of mercy, butcher."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-242: His eyes flare crimson. Blood bubbling from his wounds as his body twists unnaturally. His final words slither into a roar as bone tears through his flesh.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-244: You kneel beside him, pressing against his wounds, but the life is already leaving his frail body.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-246: "A fool's kindness... still, I shall reward it."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-248: His lips curl into a bitter smile. With the last off his strength, he slams a bony hand onto the ground.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-249: With this act, the monk's life ends. His body collapses lifelessly to the ground.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-25: "Thirty coins. And I forget you were ever here."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-250: The soil churns violently as a skeletal warrior claws its way out, its empty sockets glowing with unholy fire.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-251: Event opening (Quests “Heart of the Barbarian” Not yet appeared)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-252: Ahead stands a dead, twisted tree. Several thick iron spikes protrude from its trunk, their bases crusted with dried blood.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-253: Someone was nailed to this tree. Judging by the rust, it happened long ago.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-254: Event opening (Received Ronan’s mission to find a helmet, The helmet has not been found yet)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-255: A dead tree stands ahead, its trunk studded with thick iron spikes. Dried blood stains the bark beneath them.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-256: Someone was nailed here a long time ago. The spikes are badly rusted, but the bloodstains remain.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-257: Event opening (There are still enemies alive (Giant Rat))
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-260: "Thank you! I thought I was done for. Here, take this," he says, pressing a small iron key into your hand.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-261: "It's for my chest... my supplies. You've earned it. I'm getting out of this cursed place while I still can."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-262: "Perhaps our paths will cross again someday. Until then, safe travels."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-263: You emerge from the darkness into a small forest clearing. But there is no relief in the open air. Shredded canvas, splintered wood, and scattered crates lie strewn across. All that remains of what must have once been a merchant's wagon.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-264: Blood is soaked into the earth, splashed across leaves, pooling between broken wheels. At the center lies the mangled body of the unfortunate driver, barely recognizable. Deep claw marks scar the surrounding trees and crates. The air still reeks of blood and wet fur.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-265: A desperate scream draws you toward a clearing. A trader stands atop a battered wooden cart, surrounded by oversized rats.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-266: He is desperately swinging a wooden staff at a swarm of oversized rats. Trader is barely keeping the creatures at bay. His voice trembles. "I - I don't want to die like this! Please, help me!"
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-267: How are you going to act?
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-274: You take aim and fire. The shot cuts through the air and strikes the lead rat squarely in the head.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-275: The creature screeches and tumbles aside, dazed but alive.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-277: You snap open a small vial and cast the powder low across the clearing.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-278: A pale cloud blooms near the cart. The rats shriek, clawing at their eyes as panic spreads through the swarm.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-28: "How about we make it twenty?" (Requires Thief)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-280: You lower your shoulder and charge through the swarm, roaring like a storm breaking against stone. The ground trembles as steel meets fur.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-281: For a heartbeat, the rats freeze - their chittering dies in their throats as fear ripples through the pack. Then they scream and surge again.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-283: You leave him to his fate, his screams echoing through the trees. The rats are having dinner tonight.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-286: The sun still hangs high as your boots leave the last stretch of road and cross into the forest. The path ahead is open. Adventure awaits. Treasure, glory, danger, and tales not yet told.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-3: Event opening (Processing the Burrower, Enemy defeated (Burrower))
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-30: Appeal to his sense of duty. (Requires Paladin)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-32: You step closer, towering over the guard.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-33: He looks you up and down.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-34: The guard makes no attempt to retreat.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-35: Instead, he gives you an amused smirk.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-36: "Good," he says. "The monsters out there are waiting. Settle it with them, not me."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-37: Choose “Appeal to his sense of duty.”
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-38: You speak of duty, of order, of what is right.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-39: For a brief moment, something shifts in his expression... then fades.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-4: Garric straightens up as you approach, scanning your armor for blood. "Well, look at that. You're still breathing. And more importantly - so am I..."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-40: "Save it," he mutters. "This post isn't held by ideals."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-41: "If you care that much," he says, "then go do something useful."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-42: He gestures past him, into the wild.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-43: "Monsters are waiting. Deal with them first."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-45: "Suit yourself. Sword's still not swinging, and the monsters are still breathing."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-47: Choose “How about we make it twenty?” (Have at least 20 gold coins)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-48: "Heh... I see you know the game." Garric glances around and palms the coins with surprising speed.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-49: "Twenty it is." He steps aside, pretending to study the treeline. "Gate's open. Well, if we had one."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-50: Choose “How about we make it twenty?” (Fewer than 20 gold coins)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-51: "Oh, charming. Truly. Trying to bribe me without coins?" Garric smirks.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-52: "You know what, hero? Let's do it the hard way. Kill the damn beasts and we'll talk again."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-53: Choose “Pay 30 coins.” (Have at least 30 Gold Coins)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-54: "Pleasure doing business. Now go on in. And if you get yourself killed, do it quietly. I'd hate for paperwork to get involved."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-56: "Not enough? Charming. Truly. Then you'll have to do it the old-fashioned way. The beasts are still breathing. And that, apparently, is your problem now."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-57: You emerge from the dense forest into a sunlit glade. Wildflowers of every color sway gently in the breeze, filling the air with their sweet scent.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-58: At the center of the clearing stands a small, weathered wooden hut. No signs of life stir. No movement, no sound beyond the rustling leaves.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-59: Though the place feels abandoned, an eerie sense of calm settles over you.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-6: "Gate's open." He bows with a sarcastic smile and steps aside, gesturing toward the village trail. "... you get the idea."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-60: "Let me check for traces of the Void." (Requires Voidcaller)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-64: You kneel and study the soft earth around the clearing.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-65: You find tracks everywhere around the glade. Deer, rabbits, foxes, even wolves.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-66: Nothing unusual. Whatever once lived here never frightened the wildlife away.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-68: You close your eyes and reach beyond the physical world.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-69: Nothing answers. No corruption. No malice.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-7: "Go on in. You've earned it. And if anyone gives you trouble, tell 'em Garric owes you a drink."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-70: Only silence and an unexpected sense of peace.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-71: Choose “Let me check for traces of the Void.”
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-72: You reach outward, searching for traces of the Void.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-74: Then, for the briefest moment, you catch something in the air. A thin strand. Faint. Concealed.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-76: Cold wind whistles between the rocks.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-77: Then, just for a heartbeat, you catch movement near the highest ridge. A tall figure wrapped in a red cloak stands against the sky.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-78: Before you can focus on it, the figure disappears behind the rocks.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-79: "Someone was up there. Watching us." (Requires Ranger)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-8: The trees thin into a narrow, muddy trail. A lone guard leans on his spear beside the path. His armor is worn, and he looks like he hasn't slept properly in days.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-83: You narrow your eyes and focus on the distant ridge.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-84: Nothing. The rocks reveal no secrets.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-86: "Whoever that was, they knew exactly where to stand to avoid being seen." you whisper while watching the cliffs.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-87: Choose “Someone was up there. Watching us.”
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-88: "Red cloak. High on the ridge. Definitely not a trick of the light."
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-89: Event opening (The snake hasn't left the tree hole yet)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-9: "Well now... look what the trees dragged in." His voice is dry, almost bored.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-90: Ahead, half hidden by shrubs, rises a low rocky outcrop. Its surface is split with cracks where tufts of grass and weeds have rooted. At the base, near a clump of yellow brush, you notice a small round hole - no wider than a hand.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-91: Event opening (The snake has left the tree hole)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-92: The rocky outcrop looks the same, though the hole at its base lies quiet now. The earth around it is freshly disturbed.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-93: Dialogue options (Snake hasn't left the cave)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-94: Examine the rocks and the hole more closely.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-96: Probe the hole with a stick or weapon.
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-97: "Wait... there's life inside." (Party member required: Elk, Available once)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-98: "Use brute force and give the rock pile a proper kick." (Requires a Warrior, Available once)
maps.points.starting_forest.dialogue-99: Dialogue options (Snake has left the cave)

maps.points.starting_forest.m03.detail: "Here I rest, yet whisper still, Find my secret - if you have the will."
maps.points.starting_forest.m06.detail: It reads: He always wanted to be under the weather.
maps.points.starting_forest.m07.detail: Gone from this world, yet watching in shadow.
maps.points.starting_forest.m17.detail: "Here lies Grom the Mighty Swung his axe with all his might, but forgot to duck in the final fight."
maps.points.starting_forest.n01.detail: The dim torchlight barely penetrates the dark tunnel, its jagged walls clawed and gnawed by countless vermin.
maps.points.starting_forest.n02.detail: The trader's body is torn apart. It looks like the rats dragged all of his belongings into a nearby burrow.
maps.points.starting_forest.n02.detail-3: After completing the mechanism at that location:Quarterstaff

maps.points.starting_forest.n06.detail: A strange scent hangs in the air. Sour, sweet, and faintly poisonous. Ahead lies a vast apple orchard, long abandoned.
maps.points.starting_forest.n07.detail: The grave was opened by some animal. Bones lie scattered, picked clean.
maps.points.starting_forest.n08.detail: Cracked stones and shattered tree trunks are strewn about, making it clear that forcing a path through is impossible.
